usage: agentware plan lint [-h] [--format {text,json}] --path PATH [--strict]
                           [--readiness]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --path PATH           path to a plan.md
  --strict              treat the R9 autonomy rule (and the R13 done-reality
                        binding) as hard failures (used by the loop pre-hook
                        so a non-autonomous plan aborts before the run)
  --readiness           check ONLY the mechanical draft->ready gate: no
                        emitter placeholder signatures remain and >=1 real
                        acceptance checkbox exists
